title: JD Vance Called Michigan Senate Candidate Abdul El-Sayed ‘Evil’ in Speech
summary: Vice President JD Vance also told Dr. Abdul El-Sayed, Michigan’s Democratic Senate nominee, to “keep my wife’s name out of your mouth.”
